Ta có: $\vec{MA} + 3\vec{MB} = \vec{0} \Leftrightarrow \vec{MA} + 3(\vec{MA} + \vec{AB}) = \vec{0}$.\\
		$\Leftrightarrow \displaystyle \vec{MA} = -\frac{3}{4}\vec{AB}$.\\
		Gọi $M(x;y;z)$.\\ 
		Ta có: $\vec{MA} = (2-x; 2-y; 3-z)$; $\vec{AB} = (0; -4; -4)$.\\
		Từ $\displaystyle \vec{MA} = -\frac{3}{4}\vec{AB} \Leftrightarrow \displaystyle \begin{cases} 2-x = -\frac{3}{4}.0 \\ 2-y = -\frac{3}{4}.(-4) \\ 3-z = -\frac{3}{4}.(-4) \end{cases} \Leftrightarrow \displaystyle \begin{cases} x=2 \\ y=-1 \\ z=0 \end{cases}$.\\
		Vậy $M(2;-1;0)$.\\
